resolution: The visible 'alignment is messed up between the 2D paint map and the 3D iso pane' was the iso GRID coarsening too early (fixed in 739223361 / req_0440): pieces snap to the real 1 tile = 1 m grid (the same grid the 2D map and game use — verified: WORLD_TUNING.defaultCellSizeMeters=1, snap gridMeters=1, graphToBuildWorld offsets by the even CHUNK_TILES/2=60 so no half-cell skew), they just didn't sit on the visibly-drawn coarse lines until zoomed in. With the grid holding 1-tile pitch through the build range, pieces read as on-grid at the zooms you place at. SEPARATE remaining item (not a coordinate bug): the 2D place layer draws each building as its bounding RECTANGLE (footW x footD), so an L-shaped building shows as a rectangle in 2D while the 3D shows the true piece shape — making the 2D footprint render the real piece outline is a distinct follow-up, surfaced for prioritization. Grid alignment committed 739223361.
